stuck.title: Stuck?
stuck.hint: Paste the error, copy the prompt, ask free ChatGPT.

official-page-only.title: Official page only
official-page-only.script: Installing an AI agent changes more often than a guide like this can keep up with, so I do not read steps to you here. We link to the official install page of your AI agent, which always has the current steps, and we only tell you what to look for. You can follow that page line by line and come straight back.

claude-code-preferred.title: Claude Code preferred
claude-code-preferred.script: I prefer Claude Code, and the workshop is built around it. Antigravity, Codex and GitHub Copilot work as well, so pick yours in the toolbar and the page follows your choice. If you have no preference, choose Claude Code and you will see the same screens as I do.

it-tells-you-when-it-worked.title: It tells you when it worked
it-tells-you-when-it-worked.script: You know the install worked when your AI agent shows its start screen in the terminal, and the page shows you what that looks like. If you see it, you are done with this step. If you do not, that is what the troubleshooting box is for.
